title: MZ Single-actor system with menu change

posts.author: jedite1000
posts.body:
I’m working on a new project in RPG Maker MZ and I’m planning to have only
one actor in the party at all times
.
I’ve run into a small UI issue with the default menu—since it’s designed for multiple party members, the actor is displayed on the left side and there’s a large empty space where additional actors would normally appear.
What I’d like to achieve is a more streamlined setup where:
The menu is adjusted for a
single actor
(no empty space)
You
don’t need to select the actor
when opening things like the status/equipment screens—it just goes straight to that character
I’m trying to avoid using VisuStella MZ Plugins this time due to compatibility issues with other plugins.
Is there a way to achieve this with eventing, script calls, or lightweight plugins? Or is this something that would require editing the menu scenes directly?
Any advice or recommendations would be appreciated!
